steps.js: const top=document.querySelector('header.v3-top'); const steps=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v3-steps .v3-step')].map(b=>{const sp=b.querySelector('span'); const sm=b.querySelector('small'); return {label:sp?.innerText, spanTrunc: sp? sp.scrollWidth>sp.clientWidth+1:null, spanW: sp?.clientWidth, smallText: sm?.innerText, smallVis: sm? getComputedStyle(sm).display!=='none' && sm.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 : false, smallTrunc: sm? sm.scrollWidth>sm.clientWidth+1:null, btnTrunc: b.scrollWidth>b.clientWidth+1}}); const chip=document.querySelector('.infra-pop'); const chipBtn=chip?.querySelector('button'); const rt=document.querySelector('.rt-btn'); const gpu=document.querySelector('.v3-gpu'); return {steps, chipText: chipBtn?.innerText, chipTitle: chipBtn?.title?.slice(0,300), chipDot: chip?.querySelector('.infra-dot')?.className, rtText: rt?.innerText, gpuText: gpu?.innerText, topOverflow: top? top.scrollWidth>top.clientWidth+1:null}

const p=document.querySelector('.infra-panel'); return p? {text:p.innerText, hasPort:/\b(18[1-3]\d\d|8800|8870|8188|8189|8190|8191)\b/.test(p.innerText.replace(p.querySelector('details.infra-tech')?.innerText||'','')), hasApi:/\/api\//.test(p.innerText)} : 'no panel'

const imgs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.gl-thumb img, .gpu-drawer img, [class*=gpu] img')]; const thumbs=imgs.map(i=>({src:(i.currentSrc||i.src).slice(-90), complete:i.complete, nat:i.naturalWidth})); const none=[...document.querySelectorAll('.gl-thumb-none')].map(x=>x.innerText); const panel=document.querySelector('.infra-panel'); const dr=document.querySelector('[class*=gpu-drawer], aside[class*=gpu], .gpu-panel'); return {thumbs, broken: thumbs.filter(t=>t.complete && t.nat===0).length, none, infraTop: panel?.innerText?.slice(0,600), drawerText: (dr||document.body).innerText.slice(0,3000)}
const b=document.querySelector('.rt-btn'); const d=document.querySelector('.rt-drawer'); return {btn:b?.innerText, title:b?.title, drawer: d?.innerText?.slice(0,800)}

const steps=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v3-steps .v3-step')].map(b=>{const sp=b.querySelector('span'); const sm=b.querySelector('small'); return {label:sp?.innerText, spanTrunc: sp? sp.scrollWidth>sp.clientWidth+1:null, spanW: sp?.clientWidth, smallVis: sm? getComputedStyle(sm).display!=='none' && sm.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 : false, btnTrunc: b.scrollWidth>b.clientWidth+1}}); const chip=document.querySelector('.infra-pop button'); const rt=document.querySelector('.rt-btn'); return {steps, chipText: chip?.innerText, rtText: rt?.innerText}

const steps=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v3-steps .v3-step')].map(b=>{const sp=b.querySelector('span'); const sm=b.querySelector('small'); return {label:sp?.innerText, spanTrunc: sp? sp.scrollWidth>sp.clientWidth+1:null, smallText: sm?.innerText, smallVis: sm? getComputedStyle(sm).display!=='none' && sm.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 : false, smallTrunc: sm? sm.scrollWidth>sm.clientWidth+1:null}}); return {steps, rt: document.querySelector('.rt-btn')?.innerText, chip: document.querySelector('.infra-pop button')?.innerText}
